label: MIC4574
description:
MIC4574 0.5-A Step-Down Voltage Regulator in DIP8 package.


The MIC4574 improves on the LM2574 by increasing the switching frequency to 200Khz, allowing the use of smaller inductors and capacitors. It is pin-compatible.
